hypotheses.G0_greedy_discovery_error_decreases_mono: Exact coordinated greedy selection never reduces discovery fidelity as channels are added.
hypotheses.G1_greedy_512_channels_are_loss_sufficie: A frozen coordinated 512-channel bank retains at least 0.90 CE derivative fidelity on every corpus.
hypotheses.G2_greedy_materially_beats_marginal: At 512 channels, coordinated greedy selection exceeds the retained marginal bank by at least 0.10 on every corpus.
hypotheses.G3_greedy_2048_channels_are_high_fidelit: A frozen coordinated 2,048-channel bank retains at least 0.95 on every corpus.
hypotheses.G4_greedy_bank_transfers_ood: At 512 channels, each OOD fidelity is within 0.05 of FineWeb.
hypotheses.G5_greedy_native_k90_is_at_most_1024: Every corpus reaches 90% with at most 1,024 coordinated channels.
hypotheses.G6_coordination_reorders_channels: Fewer than half of the coordinated top 512 channels are in the marginal top 512.
